# GEO report: acme-mugs **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 24–33/100, At risk Confidence: High (checked 21 of 23 points). How it's calculated: low = 5.5 ÷ 23 × 100 = 24. High = (5.5 + 2) ÷ 23 × 100 = 33. Your `robots.txt` tells every crawler to stay away from the whole site. The pages are also built in the browser, so crawlers that don't run JavaScript see an empty page. Both are quick to confirm and fixable. The one unknown is the canonical link (the page's declared main address), which needs your domain. I assumed you want search and AI search tools to find this site. There is no `geo.config.json`. The cap of 40 applies because of the site-wide block, but it doesn't bind here because the score is already below 40. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Let crawlers read the site (fix robots.txt) - **Why it matters:** `Disallow: /` asks every crawler, search and AI alike, not to read any page, so the site can't be found. - **Where:** `public/robots.txt:1-2` - **What the code says:** `User-agent: *` / `Disallow: /` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 50–59. This clears GEO-009 and GEO-014. If you deliberately want to stay hidden, tell me and I'll drop this item. ### 2. Put page content in the HTML the server sends - **Why it matters:** many crawlers don't run JavaScript. They get an empty `
` instead of your mug descriptions and catalogue. - **Where:** `index.html:8`, `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:5-7` - **What the code says:** `
`, and the catalogue is fetched in the browser with `fetch('/api/mugs')` inside `useEffect`. - **Size:** Large. You'd prerender or server-render the pages, for example with a prerender plugin or a framework like React Router framework mode. - **Score after this:** 37–46 (from today's results). ### 3. Give every page a real title, description and language - **Why it matters:** the title and description are what people and machines read first about a page. Every page currently looks the same. - **Where:** `index.html:2` and `index.html:5` - **What the code says:** `` has no `lang`, `Vite App`, and there is no meta description. - **Size:** Small. Set `lang` and a description here, and give each route its own title. - **Score after this:** 33–41 (from today's results). ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Live | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is readable and valid | Clear | Not run | `public/robots.txt` is valid and tiny | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers have the access you want | Problem | Not run | `public/robots.txt:2` `Disallow: /` under `User-agent: *`; site-wide | | GEO-014 | Pages are indexable | Problem | Not run | `public/robots.txt:2` blocks Googlebot and Bingbot through `*`; 2 of 2 routes. No noindex tag found | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical link | Can't tell | Not run | No canonical in `index.html`, and no domain declared. Tell me your domain | | GEO-003 | Content is in the server HTML | Problem | Not run | `index.html:8` `
`; 2 of 2 routes | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid | Not applicable | Not run | No JSON-LD found | | GEO-011 | Sitemap exists and robots.txt points to it | Problem | Not run | No sitemap file, and no `Sitemap:` line in `public/robots.txt` | | GEO-012 | Title, description and `lang` | Problem | Not run | `index.html:2`, `index.html:5`; 2 of 2 routes | | GEO-016 | Key pages reachable by real links | Problem | Not run | `src/main.jsx:11`; /catalogue is reached only through a button (1 of 1 routes needing a link) | | GEO-017 | No snippet restrictions | Clear | Not run | No `nosnippet` or `max-snippet` in `index.html`; no middleware or headers config | | GEO-002 | Accessibility basics | Problem | Not run | `src/pages/Home.jsx:5` has an `` with no `alt`; /catalogue is clear (1 of 2 routes) | | GEO-101 | Mobile app files | Not applicable | Not run | No app declared | | GEO-010 | llms.txt (information only) | Not applicable | Not run | Not present. It's optional and unscored | ## Other problems found - **The catalogue is invisible without JavaScript and the API:** `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:6` has `fetch('/api/mugs')`. Prerender the list, or load it on the server, so the mug names are in the page. - **Navigation uses a button, not a link:** `src/main.jsx:11` has ``. Use `` so the page is a real link crawlers can follow. ## Worth considering - **Describe the hero image:** `src/pages/Home.jsx:5`: ``. Add an `alt` that says what's shown. It helps screen readers and machines. - **Give each mug its own page:** `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:11`: `{items.map((m) =>

{m.name}

)}`. Each mug is just a name in a paragraph. Pages like `/catalogue/` with a description and price would give each one an address that can be found and linked. - **Say more on the home page:** `src/pages/Home.jsx:6`: `Thrown by hand in Bristol and shipped worldwide.` This is the only description of the shop. Add the materials, sizes, prices and shipping details. Facts like these could also be labelled with structured data (`Product`). - **Add a viewport tag:** `index.html:4`: ``. There is no ``, which affects how phones render the page. ## Can't tell from code - **GEO-015 (canonical):** I need your site's domain to judge this. Once I have it, a canonical on each page should point to `https:///…`. - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Once the site is live, run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. - **GEO-003 in production:** hosting-level prerendering could change this. A live scan would confirm it. - **GEO-011:** I can't tell whether `/api/mugs` or any hosting layer adds more URLs. ## Assumptions - You want search engines and AI search tools to find this site. - The routes are only `/` and `/catalogue`, from `src/main.jsx`. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
